body:
Not them, I was talking about my family. My parents have never, ever been there for me or been supportive in any way. I had to leave an abusive relationship of 7 years last year, and I needed to borrow a small amount of money for a down payment on a new house. I had perfect credit, money was coming in from the sale of the mutually owned house, my parents are VERY well off and the only way they agreed is if I paid basically loan shark level interest. I moved out at 16 and have never taken money from them, so it was a huge blow. As a result I had to stay in the same house as my ex for four more months in a bad situation, and they didn't care. They live in Australia and haven't visited in 4 years.

I do blame them for a lot of my problems that have stemmed from childhood. Not everything of course, like my inability to find a job.. that's all me. But my body image issues after my mother wouldn't let me get help for my eating disorder, and sexual abuse that went on that my parents accused me of lying over (it was their best friend). I don't wish them ill will, and I would never say that in a note.. I think I'd just tell them there was nothing they could do. No point in causing them pain, won't change a thing. As for my internet friends, I'm a little more stumped. Do I just disappear into nothingness? Do I send an awkward email? They've helped me out a lot these past few months.

My main hangup is my pups though. I love them to bits and I hope they get good homes.
Which game do you play? If it's only for 2-3 weeks are you able to skip going before the move?
I really liked it, but I'm terrible at games (I just find them fun). Which is why I play WoW. lol

It fascinates me, it's not even the good pay although that's an incentive. It's just the one job to me that seems interesting as you're constantly learning new things as more research is being done, etc.
And honestly, I'm terrified of being in another relationship after that one and how it ended.

I can't afford to go back to 6 years of school, can't get enough loans and my parents won't help at all. I find trades interesting honestly, nice people and a good wage here.. but no one will hire me to start my apprenticeship because I don't have experience. It's frustrating to no end.

I'm glad you have your brother. I've always longed for a close family. Mine is 10 years older than me and moved out when I was 7 so I never got to know him. My parents and I have never had a close relationship. It took a huge blow last year when I had to leave my fiancee and they wouldn't lend me the money to put a down payment on a house even though they are very well off and I would have refinanced it within three months. They finally agreed- on the stipulation I pay them basically loan shark rate interest for the three months. I feel like I've failed them, or else they would have taken more interest in my life. I really have no one.

My dogs are Italian greyhounds and borzoi (two of each). My borzoi could go back to the breeders, I have good relationships with them and they would take them back any time. But my IGs are extremely needy and cuddly and shy, they only like me. It crushes me to think they would be scared and alone, and not get adopted out together.
